message.content:
This editorial illustration features a blue background with large white letters spelling "TEMPO" across the upper third. Centrally, a stylized male figure in a dark suit, red tie, and black songkok hat performs a split in mid-air. He is physically braced between two large, upright ballistic missiles. His arms are outstretched, with his hands gripping the missiles.

The left missile is primarily white with a black conical tip and blue fins at the base. It displays a blue rectangle containing a white hexagram between two horizontal blue stripes. The right missile is primarily black with a yellow conical tip and a yellow band near the top. It displays a small flag with horizontal green, white, and red stripes and a central red emblem. 

Below the figure, large black text reads "ANGAN-ANGAN JURU DAMAI". Further down, smaller black text describes international tensions and a proposal by "Presiden Prabowo." Other legible text includes "Modus Perdagangan Orang di Maumere H.24" and "Nasida Ria Kembali Menyala H.50" at the top, and "9-15 MARET 2026" with a barcode in the bottom right corner. Pinkish-white cloud-like shapes appear at the bottom.
